creative.name: One move, one lesson
creative.headline:
ONE LOST MOVE.
ONE NEW HABIT.
creative.body: Review the threat you missed before your next game.
creative.note: Five minutes. One position. One cue.
creative.alternate:
REVIEW THE MOVE.
KEEP THE LESSON.
creative.caption: After a blitz loss, review one consequential decision. Rewind, name the threat, test your move against a forcing reply, and write one cue for next time. Read the full lesson and practise in the Academy.
creative.measure: Saves per reach; qualified Academy visits; completed practice where measured
sequence: Ask which move changed the game.
Reveal 2...Rd8 3.Rxd8# and write the cue: check the back rank before moving its defender.
